title: Iowa alumnus turns UI memories into music for Voxman anniversary
summary_en: UI communication studies graduate Scott Icenogle has fond memories of his time at Iowa, from football Saturdays to film projects and food with friends. His musical tribute, Ode to Voxman, will premiere Oct. 29 as part of the Voxman Music Building’s 10th anniversary celebration.
title_cn: Iowa alumnus turns UI memories into music for Voxman anniversary

title: Iowa Pulitzer Prize winner to discuss memoir from the abyss
summary_en: Iowa Writers’ Workshop graduate Yiyun Li won a 2026 Pulitzer Prize for her memoir, Things in Nature Merely Grow, which explores the devastating loss of her two sons to suicide six years apart. Li returns to campus Oct. 23 to discuss her book and her time at Iowa.
title_cn: Iowa Pulitzer Prize winner to discuss memoir from the abyss

title: A healthy addition to Tiffin: UI Health Care opens new family medicine clinic
summary_en: University of Iowa Health Care’s new family medicine clinic in Tiffin is now open and welcoming patients.
title_cn: A healthy addition to Tiffin: UI Health Care opens new family medicine clinic

title: New UI AI Industry Advisory Board helps prepare campus for future of work
summary_en: The new University of Iowa AI Industry Advisory Board connects university leaders with industry experts to help understand how artificial intelligence is reshaping the workplace and prepare students, faculty, and staff to thrive in an AI-enabled workforce.
title_cn: New UI AI Industry Advisory Board helps prepare campus for future of work
